name: Automotive & Mobility
description: Sector pack for OEMs, Tier-1/2 suppliers, and mobility companies. Covers SASB TR-AU, ESRS E1/E5, EU fleet CO2 regulation, Catena-X PCF exchange, and the EU Battery Regulation passport.

license.note: Drivetrain factors derived from published OEM sustainability reports (BMW 2024, VW 2024) and the GREET lifecycle model.
